newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Aegon lifts Q1 profit 24 percent.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Aegon lifts Q1 profit 24 percent.

text.p: Dutch insurer Aegon NV on Thursday announced a 24 percent increase in net profit to 403.4 million guilders ($211.9 million) for the first quarter of 1997.
The company also said it expected 1997 full-year net profit and earnings per share to be 15 percent higher than in 1996.
"Aegon has upgraded its earnings forecast for 1997," the company said in a statement.

"Barring unforeseen circumstances...and not taking into account the impact of the acquisition of Providian, we expect an increase in 1997 net profit and earnings per share in guilders of some 15 percent," Aegon said.
Aegon said that, on top of that, its planned acquisition of the insurance activities of Providian Corporation would have a positive impact on earnings per share.
The result was at the upper end of analysts' expectations.
Aegon shares initially strengthened to 142.60 guilders in response to the announcement before easing to 141.50 at 1245 GMT, down 10 cents from the previous close.
Aegon said earlier that it expected to finalise the acquisition of the insurance activities of Providian by June or July. ($ = 1.903 Dutch Guilders)
